  bed_h <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_1_hrs))
  bed <- case_when(
    bed_h %in% 5:11 ~ bed_h + 12,
    bed_h %in% c(0, 12, 24) ~ 24,
    bed_h %in% 1:4 ~ bed_h + 24,
    bed_h %in% 13:23 ~ bed_h,
    .default = NA_real_
  ) +
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_1_min)) / 60
  wake_h <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_3_hrs))
  wake <- if_else(wake_h %in% 0:23, wake_h, NA_real_) + as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_3_min)) / 60
  (wake - bed) %% 24
})
notes: Parent report, waves 1, 4 and 8 (no bed or wake times at wave 12): usual weeknight bedtime ('What is [child]'s usual bedtime on weeknights?', CSHQ1_1) to usual weekday wake time (CSHQ1_3), hours and minutes boxes, (wake - bed) mod 24. Hour boxes labelled PM 1-12 for bedtime and AM 1-12 for waking, with a dropdown that ran past 12: bedtimes 5-11 read as PM, 12 (and 0 or 24) as midnight, 1-4 as after midnight, 13-23 as the 24-hour clock; wake times 1-12 as written (12 = noon) and 0-23 as the 24-hour clock; other codes (bedtime 25, 40; wake 34, 37) NA. Partial: bedtime, not sleep onset. Durations under 4 or over 16 hours kept.

local({
  bed_h_wd <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_1_hrs))
  bed_wd <- case_when(
    bed_h_wd %in% 5:11 ~ bed_h_wd + 12,
    bed_h_wd %in% c(0, 12, 24) ~ 24,
    bed_h_wd %in% 1:4 ~ bed_h_wd + 24,
    bed_h_wd %in% 13:23 ~ bed_h_wd,
    .default = NA_real_
  ) +
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_1_min)) / 60
  wake_h_wd <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_3_hrs))
  wake_wd <- if_else(wake_h_wd %in% 0:23, wake_h_wd, NA_real_) + as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_3_min)) / 60
  bed_h_we <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_2_hrs))
  bed_we <- case_when(
    bed_h_we %in% 5:11 ~ bed_h_we + 12,
    bed_h_we %in% c(0, 12, 24) ~ 24,
    bed_h_we %in% 1:4 ~ bed_h_we + 24,
    bed_h_we %in% 13:23 ~ bed_h_we,
    .default = NA_real_
  ) +
    as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_2_min)) / 60
  wake_h_we <- as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_4_hrs))
  wake_we <- if_else(wake_h_we %in% 0:23, wake_h_we, NA_real_) + as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(CSHQ1_4_min)) / 60
  avg <- (5 * ((wake_wd - bed_wd) %% 24) + 2 * ((wake_we - bed_we) %% 24)) / 7
  avg
})
notes: Waves 1, 4 and 8 only: (5 x hlth_sleep_wd + 2 x hlth_sleep_we) / 7, parent-reported bedtime to waking (clock reading as hlth_sleep_wd). Wave 12 has no bed or wake times and is NA: its only sleep item, the study's 'Sleep per day hours' (CSHQ_hours, usual sleep per day including naps), is a different item, which fills a missed wave only on rows standardised within wave. Partial: bedtime rather than sleep onset. CSHQ_hours, its items (CSHQ1_5) and the study's s_dur_m are unused. Durations under 4 or over 16 hours kept.

Parent report, abbreviated Children's Sleep Habits Questionnaire total sleep disturbances (CSHQ_sleepTOT): 7 items (consistent bedtime, falls asleep within 20 minutes, consistent sleep duration, restless sleep, night wakings, daytime tiredness, falling asleep during activities) on a 4-point usually-to-never scale, higher = more disturbance (Rojo-Wissar et al. 2024, doi:10.1111/camh.12665, Measures); range 7-28, observed 7-25; waves 1, 4, 8 and 12. Study-supplied sum used as released, missing-item rule not documented. The study's s_dis_m (mean of the 4- and 8-month totals) is unused.
